home.title: Two areas of expertise, one single mission: giving you your smile back

items.desc: Dental panoramic X-ray is 2D medical imaging, completed in just a few seconds, to view all teeth, jaws, sinuses and bone on a single image. It helps detect cavities, infections, fractures, and plan treatments.
Scaling is an essential professional dental treatment to remove tartar (mineralized bacterial plaque) built up on teeth, which brushing alone cannot reach.

Root canal treatment removes the pulp from a decayed, infected or traumatized tooth to stop pain and infection. Performed under anesthesia, the procedure cleans the root canals, which are then sealed. It allows the tooth to be preserved.
Tooth extraction involves removing a tooth when it can no longer be treated, or wisdom teeth when indicated. It relieves pain, eliminates infection and prevents complications.
A dental crown is a fixed prosthesis that fully covers a damaged, root-treated or broken tooth to restore its shape, function and strength.
A dental bridge replaces one or more missing teeth in a fixed, aesthetic way.

Teeth whitening is a professional treatment that lightens the shade of your teeth and restores the brightness of your smile.
It gently reduces stains caused by time, coffee, tea or tobacco.
A dental implant is an artificial root, usually titanium, placed in the jawbone to replace a missing tooth and support a crown or bridge. This permanent solution offers comfort and aesthetics.
Orthodontic treatment aligns teeth and gradually corrects misalignment for an aesthetic and functional result. It improves hygiene, comfort and helps achieve a harmonious smile.

Dental aligners are custom-made appliances used to straighten teeth (orthodontics), protect against bruxism (grinding), or whiten teeth. Clear and discreet, they apply constant pressure to correct the dentition.
A removable denture replaces one, several, or all missing teeth. It is custom-made to restore chewing, speech and smile aesthetics.

Intraoral scanning is modern technology that creates a quick, comfortable 3D digital impression of your teeth. It is a precise diagnostic tool that helps you understand your situation through direct visualization.

This approach improves communication between practitioner and patient and enables more precise, personalized care.

about.title: About Our Clinic
about.body: Welcome to our DUO SMILE dental centre with Dr Mohammed Amine EL GHORFI and Dr Nassima EL FAKIR, in the heart of Temara on Avenue Hassan II. As a couple in practice, we welcome you in a calm setting to care for your oral health. From prevention to cosmetic dentistry, surgery, and orthodontics, we bring our complementary expertise to children and adults alike. Our modern facility helps us deliver gentle, precise, and long-lasting care. Book your appointment today!
